resources.string: The first 8 lessons are free. The full course has %1$d lessons, all 32 Lithuanian letters and 10 short stories. One payment, no subscription, no ads.
Purchases work when the app is installed from Google Play.
The full course is unlocked. Thank you!
Test build: all lessons are unlocked.
One lesson a day is enough: 5 to 10 minutes.
Sit next to your child and praise every try, not only right answers.
Tapping a syllable or word reads it aloud. Ask your child to repeat it out loud.
Lessons can be repeated any time. Fewer mistakes earn more stars.
You don\'t need to speak Lithuanian to help: the app says every letter, syllable and word itself. Everything your child sees stays in Lithuanian.
The app collects no data about your child or you, shows no ads and works offline.
